parties: The Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) acquires Oriental Hotels Limited
headline: IHCL and Oriental Hotels Limited announce Merger
sum: The Indian Hotels Company Limited announces merger with Oriental Hotels Limited, consolidating the Tata Group's hospitality portfolio. The transaction combines two established hotel operating companies in the Indian hospitality sector.
implication: All-stock hospitality consolidation within Tata Group; precedent for inter-group scheme of merger under Cos Act s.230-232 with potential NCLT approval pathway and regulatory filing with stock exchanges.
detail: IHCL, India's leading hospitality group operating under the Tata brand, announced the merger with Oriental Hotels Limited. The transaction is structured as a scheme of arrangement and requires regulatory approval including NCLT sanction and shareholder voting. Key conditions include satisfaction of all closing mechanics and regulatory clearances under the Companies Act, 2013 and stock exchange requirements.
